Citymaker.Recipe.OrchardPark.Description: An orchard open as a park: fruit trees in rows with mown aisles, blossom meadow, picnics under the trees, beehives and a cider stand.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.Name: Orchard park
Citymaker.OrchardPark.style.Tooltip: Which fruit the orchard grows. Presets set the layout to match; automatic trees prefer that fruit when it is installed.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.grid.Tooltip: Square grid, quincunx (every other row offset, like dice fives), tight rows with wide alleys, or blocks of one variety each.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.spacing.Tooltip: Distance between the trees (rows: trees closer in the row, alleys wider).
Citymaker.OrchardPark.rowAngle.Tooltip: Rows along the area's long side, across it, or diagonally.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.paths.Tooltip: A cross through the middle, a grid of blocks, a loop inside the edge, or a blossom avenue lined with trees.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.blockSize.Tooltip: Distance between the grid paths, and the size of the variety blocks.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.gaps.Tooltip: Share of planting spots left empty, as in a real old orchard.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.windbreak.Tooltip: A row of tall trees along the edge sheltering the orchard.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.meadow.Tooltip: Share of the orchard floor left as long meadow (painted patches with wildflowers).
Citymaker.OrchardPark.flowers.Tooltip: Flower clumps per hectare, mostly in the meadow patches.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.mownAisles.Tooltip: Mown strips painted between the tree rows. Permanent terrain texture.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.lawn.Tooltip: Covers the whole orchard with a mown grass surface (cherry blossom lawns).
Citymaker.OrchardPark.meadowLayer.Toolti: Terrain layer (1–4) for the meadow patches. Which texture each is depends on the map.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.aisleLayer.Tooltip: Terrain layer (1–4) for the mown aisles.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.picnicSpots.Toolti: Picnic tables in the shade between the trees, beside the paths.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.benchEvery.Tooltip: A bench along the paths every this many metres (0 = none).
Citymaker.OrchardPark.harvestProps.Toolt: Fruit crates and ladders under a few trees.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.glade.Tooltip: An open lawn in the middle with a veteran tree and benches round it; features like a fountain go there.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.Issue.NoGlade: Orchard park: no room for the central glade.
Citymaker.OrchardPark.Issue.NoTrees: Orchard park: no room for fruit trees. Make the spacing smaller or the area bigger.
